svg.title: Token Quotient demo: a quote with levels before an AI job, the real cost after, big jobs in nightly installments
svg.desc: A terminal. The user asks Claude Code for a big job. Quotient shows a quote with three levels (essential, good, max), each with its work, chat part and total, and the share of the 5-hour and weekly limits. The user picks good, all today; Quotient reports the real cost against the estimate and updates its correction factor. Then a job too big for one day is paced over 4 days, about 400k a day: the first installment runs tonight at 03:00, the PC wakes, works up to the day's cap and hibernates again; after 4 nights the report is waiting in the chat.

text.tspan: Port the payments client to async, with tests. Big job.
